Not exactly. Cave art would likely fall under small-scale technology, technology in which Ted argues is a form of technology that can be used by small-scale communities without outside assistance and is a form of acceptable technology. Ted only aims to destroy the organisational technology, the technology reliant on several different parts and large-scale, perhaps multinational, organisation.
Ultimately I think Ted's thoughts preach self-reliance in a small community as a goal and that technology has made us all too easy to depend on complete strangers across the world for our needs, and that has led us to be unhappy as a whole.
